sentences.en: I wanted to ask you because I know that you were one of the people that actually went back today.
sentences.zh: 我想问你，因为我知道你是今天真正回去的人之一。

sentences.en: So I was wondering if you could tell me a little bit more about your journey.
sentences.zh: 所以我很想知道你能不能多跟我讲讲你的旅程。

sentences.en: I wonder if you could tell me that story.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你能不能讲讲那个故事。

sentences.en: Every house, every section, everything looked different.
sentences.zh: 每一栋房子，每一个区域，一切看起来都不一样了。

sentences.en: Everything had changed on the way.
sentences.zh: 一路上所有东西都变了。

sentences.en: And it was a strange feeling.
sentences.zh: 那是一种奇怪的感觉。

sentences.en: We had the strange feeling that this place that we had known was different from the way that we'd remembered it.
sentences.zh: 我们有一种奇怪的感觉，我们所熟悉的这个地方，与我们记忆中的样子不同了。

sentences.en: Can you describe what looked different?
sentences.zh: 你能描述一下哪里看起来不一样了吗？

sentences.en: Because this question is too hard to answer.

sentences.en: Earlier this month, after Israel and Hamas reached a ceasefire agreement, the Israeli military said it would pull back from certain areas of Gaza.
sentences.zh: 本月初，在以色列和哈马斯达成停火协议后，以色列军方表示将从加沙的某些地区撤出。

sentences.en: This meant that some Palestinians, who'd been displaced to the south, could try to return home to the north.
sentences.zh: 这意味着一些流离失所到南部的巴勒斯坦人，可以尝试回到北部的家中。

sentences.en: Foreign journalists still aren't allowed inside Gaza.
sentences.zh: 外国记者仍然不被允许进入加沙。

sentences.en: Okay, so I'm going to speak to him in Arabic firSt.
sentences.zh: 好的，我先用阿拉伯语和他交流。

sentences.en: I'm going to explain the whole setup.
sentences.zh: 我会解释整个安排。

sentences.en: And then I will start speaking in English.
sentences.zh: 然后我再开始用英语交谈。

sentences.en: So Daily producer Rochelle Banja spoke with Gazans by phone.
sentences.zh: 《每日新闻》制片人罗谢尔·班贾通过电话采访了加沙人。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Merhaba, I'm Tismani.
sentences.zh: 你好，我是蒂斯马尼。

sentences.en: Hello.
sentences.zh: 你好。

sentences.en: Hello, Mohammed.
sentences.zh: 你好，穆罕默德。

sentences.en: And followed them on their journeys north, along a seaside road, and through parts of
sentences.zh: 并跟随他们踏上北归的旅程，沿着海滨公路，穿过

sentences.en: Gaza that have been devastated by two years of war, as they tried to return home.
sentences.zh: 被两年战争摧毁的加沙部分地区，他们试图回家。

sentences.en: Um, you're going back to your house.
sentences.zh: 嗯，你要回你的房子了。

sentences.en: It's destroyed.
sentences.zh: 它被毁了。

sentences.en: Why would you go?
sentences.zh: 你为什么要回去？

sentences.en: It's so hard to describe the pain of being away from your own house.
sentences.zh: 那种远离自己家园的痛苦，真的很难描述。

sentences.en: And so the second that I heard that I could go back, I didn't think about it immediately.
sentences.zh: 所以当我听到可以回去的消息那一刻，我没有立刻去想别的。

sentences.en: Immediately, I knew in my heart that it was time for me to go back.
sentences.zh: 我内心立刻就知道，是我该回去的时候了。

sentences.en: It's Thursday, October 30th.
sentences.zh: 今天是10月30日，星期四。

sentences.en: The city of Khan Yunus, in the south of Gaza, was once known by Gazans for having some of the best watermelon in the region.
sentences.zh: 加沙南部的汗尤尼斯市，曾因拥有该地区最好的西瓜而闻名。

sentences.en: In the days following the October 7th attacks, it became known as a Hamas stronghold, and it turned into a focus of Israeli bombardment.
sentences.zh: 在10月7日袭击事件后的几天里，它被称为哈马斯的据点，并成为了以色列轰炸的焦点。

sentences.en: More recently, Khan Yunus has become an area where displaced families from across Gaza have sought refuge, waiting for an end to the war.
sentences.zh: 最近，汗尤尼斯已成为加沙各地流离失所家庭寻求避难的地方，等待战争结束。

sentences.en: And when the ceasefire was announced three weeks ago, Khan Yunus was transformed again, as people spilled onto the streets to celebrate.
sentences.zh: 当三周前宣布停火时，汗尤尼斯再次发生了变化，人们涌上街头庆祝。

sentences.en: Watching them, there was a photojournalist named Sahir Al-Ghara.
sentences.zh: 看着他们的是一位名叫萨希尔·阿尔-加拉的摄影记者。

sentences.en: He was there, capturing the moment for the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 他在那里，为《纽约时报》捕捉这一时刻。

sentences.en: So you mentioned that you were taking photos of people after the ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 你提到你在停火后拍摄了人们的照片。

sentences.en: Was there something that stood out to you?
sentences.zh: 有什么让你印象深刻的吗？

sentences.en: What touched me the most was the children.
sentences.zh: 最触动我的是孩子们。

sentences.en: They were jumping, they were laughing, and they were blowing bubbles, and they were chanting things like, we don't want to die anymore, saying things like, ceasefire, ceasefire.
sentences.zh: 他们跳着、笑着、吹着泡泡，高喊着“我们不想再死了”、“停火，停火”之类的话。

sentences.en: And I, as a photojournalist, had been taking a lot of photos of children that were displaced, that were dying, that were disabled because of the war.
sentences.zh: 作为一名摄影记者，我拍过很多流离失所、死亡、因战争而残疾的孩子的照片。

sentences.en: And I just had imagined all of these difficult moments that these children had gone through, and the fear they went through when they would hear these airstrikes,
sentences.zh: 我曾想象过这些孩子经历的所有艰难时刻，以及他们听到空袭时的恐惧，

sentences.en: the pain that they felt when they lost their parents.
sentences.zh: 还有他们失去父母时的痛苦。

sentences.en: And so I just was really touched when I saw these children finally feel this little moment of joy.
sentences.zh: 所以当我看到这些孩子终于感受到那一丝快乐时，我真的被触动了。

sentences.en: So after that, I went to Wadi Gaza, where there is the pathway that goes to the north.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，我去了瓦迪加沙，那里有一条通往北方的路。

sentences.en: And there, there was people waiting for the road to open to the north.
sentences.zh: 那里有很多人在等待道路开放前往北方。

sentences.en: And there was like, almost like a checkpoint.
sentences.zh: 就像有一个检查站一样。

sentences.en: And then the road opened, and the road was like all rubble.
sentences.zh: 然后路开了，路上全是瓦砾。

sentences.en: And then people just rushed in at once, and I started walking in with them.
sentences.zh: 人们一下子涌了进去，我也跟着他们一起走。

sentences.en: To go home, to go north.
sentences.zh: 为了回家，为了去北方。

sentences.en: Many people traveled on this one road, Al-Rashid Street, the seaside road.
sentences.zh: 许多人走的是这条路，阿尔-拉希德街，也就是海滨公路。

sentences.en: It runs along the coast, on the western side of the Gaza Strip, connecting cities like Khan Yunis in the south to Gaza City in the north.
sentences.zh: 它沿着海岸线延伸，位于加沙地带西侧，连接着南部的汗尤尼斯和北部的加沙城。

sentences.en: When the ceasefire went into effect, that road reopened, and people were finally able to return to what's left of their homes.
sentences.zh: 停火生效后，那条路重新开放，人们终于能够回到他们残破的家中。

sentences.en: Sahir joined them and started walking north.
sentences.zh: 萨希尔加入了他们，开始向北走。

sentences.en: So I was walking, there was thousands of Palestinians who were all walking by foot, and they're sort of carrying their bags, and they have a few things in them,
sentences.zh: 我走着，有成千上万的巴勒斯坦人都在步行，他们背着包，里面装着仅有的几样东西，

sentences.en: and they're all walking, and it's very dusty.
sentences.zh: 大家都在走，到处都是灰尘。

sentences.en: And on the road, there's also a man selling roasted peanuts to people who are walking by.
sentences.zh: 路上还有一个人在向路人兜售烤花生。

sentences.en: There were some people that were not walking.
sentences.zh: 也有一些人不是在步行。

sentences.en: They were on other traditional forms of transportation, like a tuk-tuk or like a car.
sentences.zh: 他们乘坐着其他传统的交通工具，比如突突车或汽车。

sentences.en: And they had their horn on the whole time, because they wanted to get there really, really faSt.
sentences.zh: 他们全程按着喇叭，因为他们想尽快赶到那里。

sentences.en: They were really excited.
sentences.zh: 他们真的很兴奋。

sentences.en: And they just wanted to make sure that people in front of them would make space for them.
sentences.zh: 他们只是想确保前面的人能给他们让路。

sentences.en: I guess I'm wondering, did people seem different?
sentences.zh: 我想知道，人们看起来有什么不同吗？

sentences.en: So people's personalities have changed so much, it's hard to describe.
sentences.zh: 人们的性格变化太大了，很难描述。

sentences.en: When I used to take photos of people getting displaced, people would come up to me, and they would complain, and they would say, why are you taking photos of me?
sentences.zh: 以前我拍流离失所的人时，人们会走过来抱怨，问我为什么要拍他们。

sentences.en: But now, they're saying the opposite.
sentences.zh: 但现在，他们说的是反话。

sentences.en: They're saying, please take my photo.
sentences.zh: 他们说，请拍我吧。

sentences.en: Why do you think that they want you to take photos of them now?
sentences.zh: 你觉得他们现在为什么想让你拍他们？

sentences.en: It's because of the situation that they're in.
sentences.zh: 是因为他们所处的境况。

sentences.en: There's a difference when you're getting displaced, and when you're coming back to your house.
sentences.zh: 流离失所和回到自己家，感觉是不一样的。

sentences.en: And you know, even today, I saw people were wearing their nice clothes because they were going back to their homes.
sentences.zh: 你知道，即使是今天，我也看到人们穿着漂亮的衣服，因为他们要回家了。

sentences.en: And so they were ready to get their photos taken.
sentences.zh: 所以他们准备好被拍照了。

sentences.en: Farther north, the seaside road passes by a place called Nusairat.
sentences.zh: 再往北，海滨公路经过一个叫努赛拉特的地方。

sentences.en: That's where I reached Nidal al-Kuhayl.
sentences.zh: 我在那里见到了尼达尔·阿尔-库海尔。

sentences.en: Unlike Sahir, and thousands of other Palestinians who were walking north that day,
sentences.zh: 与萨希尔以及那天成千上万向北走的巴勒斯坦人不同，

sentences.en: Nidal was sitting in a cafe.
sentences.zh: 尼达尔正坐在一家咖啡馆里。

sentences.en: He was watching videos of those scenes on his phone.
sentences.zh: 他在手机上看着那些场景的视频。

sentences.en: Are you planning to go back to your place in the north of Gaza now that the seaspire has happened?
sentences.zh: 既然停火已经发生，你打算现在回加沙北部的住处吗？

sentences.en: So, of course, but the place that my house is, is still in a place where the operations are ongoing.
sentences.zh: 当然想，但我家所在的那个地方，目前仍处于军事行动中。

sentences.en: And it's unknown what has actually happened to my house.
sentences.zh: 而且我的房子到底怎么样了，还是个未知数。

sentences.en: The information that we have is based on the news that said that everything in that neighborhood was destroyed.
sentences.zh: 我们得到的消息是新闻里说的，那个街区的一切都被摧毁了。

sentences.en: And so based on that, it's very possible to think that my house was destroyed.
sentences.zh: 所以基于此，很有可能我的房子也被毁了。

sentences.en: Nidal is 31.
sentences.zh: 尼达尔今年31岁。

sentences.en: He used to work as a waiter in what he describes as a famous Thai restaurant in Gaza.
sentences.zh: 他曾经在加沙一家他描述为著名的泰国餐厅当服务员。

sentences.en: It was called L'tailandi.
sentences.zh: 那家店在战争中被毁了。

sentences.en: The place was destroyed in the war.
sentences.zh: 过去几周，尼达尔一直和他的七个姐妹中的五个以及父母住在努赛拉特难民营，因为他们不得不离开北部的家。

sentences.en: For the past few weeks, Nidal's been living in Nusairat camp with five of his seven sisters and his parents since they had to leave their home in the north.
sentences.zh: 你能尽你所能描述一下那栋房子吗？

sentences.en: Can you describe that house for us as best as you remember it?
sentences.zh: 房子，我记得很清楚。

sentences.en: So the house, I remember it very well.
sentences.zh: 那是我爸爸盖的房子。

sentences.en: And my dad built this house.
sentences.zh: 那是我们家拥有的一块地。

sentences.en: It was a piece of land that my family owned.
sentences.zh: 它很朴素。

sentences.en: It was modeSt.
sentences.zh: 它很小。

sentences.en: It was small.
sentences.zh: 你走进去，会看到白色的墙和紫色的墙。

sentences.en: And you would walk in and there'd be these white walls and these purple walls.
sentences.zh: 那是客厅。

sentences.en: And that was the living room.
sentences.zh: 那是一栋老建筑。

sentences.en: And it was an old building.
sentences.zh: 它没有现代建筑那种复杂的结构。

sentences.en: It didn't have any of the modern sort of architectural complications of buildings these days.
sentences.zh: 但房子里有一种精神上的温暖。

sentences.en: But there was a sort of spiritual warmth to the house.
sentences.zh: 你走进去就会感到一种舒适。

sentences.en: And you just walked into it and you felt this kind of comfort.
sentences.zh: 就像一个老家一样。

sentences.en: Like it's like an old home.
sentences.zh: 那房子有味道吗？

sentences.en: And did the house have a smell?
sentences.zh: 房子闻起来就像外面寒冷下雨时，那种温暖的味道。

sentences.en: The house smells like what warmth smells like when it's cold and raining outside.
sentences.zh: 在加沙有一个词来形容它，

sentences.en: There's like this word for it in Gaza
sentences.zh: 你会说房子闻起来像“ulfa”，就像一种你知道的感觉，比如爱。

sentences.en: that you would say the house smells like ulfa, like a feeling that you know, like love.
sentences.zh: 我记得我的房间。

sentences.en: And I remember my room.
sentences.zh: 在我的房间里，有一张小书桌，我特别喜欢下班后有点累的时候去那里。

sentences.en: In my room I had this little desk and I especially loved going there after work when I was a bit tired.
sentences.zh: 我的小书桌，就像我的朋友一样。

sentences.en: My small desk, it was like a friend of mine.
sentences.zh: 桌上有一台小咖啡机，我喜欢下班后喝杯咖啡。

sentences.en: And on my desk I had this small coffee machine and I loved drinking this coffee after work.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我只是怀念那种感觉。

sentences.en: And, you know, I just miss that feeling.
sentences.zh: 当我想到家时，

sentences.en: When I think of a home,
sentences.zh: 我认为它是一个人最初火花开始的地方。

sentences.en: I think of it as a place where the initial spark in somebody starts.
sentences.zh: 它是你表达内心愤怒、内心喜悦、内心归属感的地方。

sentences.en: It's where you express the anger that's inside of you, the joy that's inside of you, the belonging that's inside of you.
sentences.zh: 失去家园，我无法用言语来形容那种痛苦，我不希望任何人经历那种痛苦。

sentences.en: To lose a home, I don't have words for the kind of agony that it feels and I don't wish it on anybody to know that kind of pain.
sentences.zh: 就像你大国里的小国消失了一样。

sentences.en: It's like the small country in your big country is gone.
sentences.zh: 这就是房子对我来说的意义。

sentences.en: That's what a house is to me.
sentences.zh: 你还有希望你的房子可能还屹立不倒吗？

sentences.en: Do you have any hope that your house might still be standing?
sentences.zh: 你是否还有一丝希望，觉得你的房子还在那里？

sentences.en: Do you have some hope that your house will be there?
sentences.zh: 我希望房子还在。

sentences.en: So, I hope that the house is still standing.
sentences.zh: 我是说，我真的无话可说。

sentences.en: I mean, I really have no words.
sentences.zh: 即使只剩下屋顶，

sentences.en: Even if it's just the roof,
sentences.zh: 我也会带上一块防水布，重新把它搭成一个家。

sentences.en: I'll bring a tarp and I'll just remake a house out of it.
sentences.zh: 我向上帝祈祷，如果房子还剩下什么，哪怕是一点点，我也会回去重建它，

sentences.en: And I wish to God that anything is left of the house, anything that's left of it, I will go back and I will rebuild it,
sentences.zh: 我会修复它，再次住在里面。

sentences.en: I'll restore it and I'll live in it again.
sentences.zh: 离尼达尔几英里外，摄影记者萨希尔继续向北行进。

sentences.en: A few miles away from Nidal, photojournalist Seher continued traveling north.
sentences.zh: 他一路拍摄着加沙人回家的情景，路上挤满了碎石堆和建筑的残骸。

sentences.en: He took photos as he went of Gazans headed home on a road crowded by piles of rocks and the sprawling remains of buildings.
sentences.zh: 但萨希尔不仅是在拍摄别人的旅程，他自己也在旅途中。

sentences.en: But Seher was not only taking photos of other people's journeys, he was on one himself.
sentences.zh: 因为加沙城也是他的家。

sentences.en: Because Gaza City is also his home.
sentences.zh: 那是他长大的地方。

sentences.en: It's where he grew up.
sentences.zh: 萨希尔在这场战争中已经流离失所六次了。

sentences.en: Seher's been displaced six times during this war.
sentences.zh: 有时，他和家人住在帐篷里。

sentences.en: At some points, he was living in tents with his family.
sentences.zh: 当他到达加沙城时，

sentences.en: When he got to Gaza City,
sentences.zh: 萨希尔回到了他的社区，

sentences.en: Seher made his way to his neighborhood,
sentences.zh: 塔拉勒·哈瓦。

sentences.en: Talal Hawa.
sentences.zh: 我确实回到了我的街道，我告诉你，

sentences.en: I did go back to my street and I'm telling you,
sentences.zh: 一切都变了。

sentences.en: I'm from there and I got there and I didn't recognize anything at all.
sentences.zh: 我从那里回来，当我到达时，我什么都认不出来了。

sentences.en: I couldn't even tell the streets apart.
sentences.zh: 我甚至分不清哪条是哪条街。

sentences.en: There was only half of our building standing and one more building standing.
sentences.zh: 我们那栋楼只剩下一半，还有另一栋楼也还立着。

sentences.en: And there was no other building in the entire neighborhood.
sentences.zh: 整个街区再没有别的建筑了。
